title: Gatchalian, Dy urge Asean peers to draw strength from diversity

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Philippine congressional leaders urged Southeast Asian lawmakers on Wednesday to treat their diversity as strength, with House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III comparing the bloc to stalks of rice bound together as a symbol of unity. At the opening of the 47th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Inter-Parliamentary General Assembly, Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian said that while the grouping’s cultures are distinct from each other, “we are united by a shared humanity.” “Look closely, and you will find far more that brings us together than pulls us apart,” he said.
